issues.title: "end of this quarter" raises ValueError in the freeform date parser

issues.title: WebSocket JWT cookie not Secure / SameSite None
issues.condition: superset/config.py:3013-3014 ship WEBSOCKET_JWT_COOKIE_SECURE = False and WEBSOCKET_JWT_COOKIE_SAMESITE = None; superset/websocket/channel.py:225-234 passes both to set_cookie
issues.not_planned_reason: Proposed flipping defaults, which contradicts #1's decision (upstream reverted the equivalent SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE flip in apache/superset#26005 after #24579).
